<div class="card-body">
'''Surprise Assault''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">急襲</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、１つの場所のフォース消耗を、キャンセルできる。相手の持つキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークル、一つごとに、運命数を１枚引く。引いた運命数の合計と、相手の戦闘力の合計を比較する。低いほうが、その差の分だけフォースを失う。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-113o-Video.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Surprise Assault (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Surprise-Assault-C1G.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">厳格な軍規の元に行動する帝国軍兵士達は、反乱軍の機転をきかせた待ち伏せ、突然の反撃、妨害行動に、しばしば不意をつかれた。</span>''<ref name="jp1-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Surprise assault.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at one location. Draw one destiny for each of the opponent's characters, starships, and vehicles. Compare that destiny total to the opponent's power total. The player with the lower total loses Force equal to the difference.

'''Lore:''' Imperial troops acting under strict orders were often caught off-guard by Rebel ambushes, sudden counterattacks, and sabotage.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Surprise Assault]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
